requiredClarifications.subject: Cancellation and failure classification
requiredClarifications.sourceEvidence: HealthLocalFiles.decode checks shared control before/after JSONFieldAudit and typed decode; JSONFieldAudit/control can throw CancellationError. HealthRecoveryCopies catalog already explicitly rethrows CancellationError before treating ordinary validation failure as unavailable.
requiredClarifications.gap: Contract says Data must fail legacy validation to confer eligibility, but does not explicitly exclude cancellation/operational failures from that predicate. A catch-all failure classifier could turn cancelled validation into authority.
requiredClarifications.requirement: Propagate CancellationError and cancellation/control checks at capture, revalidation, private-envelope work and final validation; only actual legacy representation/schema/record-validation rejection may establish failed Data. Root/defaults acquisition or operational validation errors abort capture/revalidation, never become a failed-origin token or success. Use same validator/plain decoder semantics with explicit error classification; recheck control before publishing token/authorizing install. Include cancelled valid Data and cancelled malformed Data controls proving no observation/preservation/install permission.

requiredClarifications.subject: Explicit lock graph and nonrecursive LocalStore boundary
requiredClarifications.sourceEvidence: BackupStorageRevision uses NSLock; LocalStore commitRestore enters writes.commit, then BackupFileTransaction.commit takes its own lock and HealthRecoveryCopies.serialized uses recursive private lock. revision/current or performWrite reacquires the nonrecursive writes lock.
requiredClarifications.gap: Contract names both serializations and common ordering but does not specify how review capture joins them or prohibit final validator callbacks from reentering LocalStore writes/revision.
requiredClarifications.requirement: Declare capture ordering LocalStore writes serialization then HealthRecoveryCopies directory serialization; commit retains writes → transaction instance lock → HealthRecoveryCopies lock. Use a validation primitive with already-captured fixed root/keys and no reentry into LocalStore revision/performWrite/commit APIs inside commit locks. Do not acquire writes while holding private/transaction locks. Preparation can serialize its bounded validation as needed but must release capture locks before detached work/await; keep final checks in the existing synchronous commit boundary. This is an implementation requirement, not proof of a current deadlock.

implementationNotes.subject: Encoded size and strict envelope shape
implementationNotes.detail: Raw4MiB expands to base64 length5,592,408 before JSON header. Declare finite envelope/manifest byte ceilings large enough for exact-limit payload, bound both encoded and decoded inputs before allocation, and validate UTF16LE even length/domain/key/type/digest. Apply existing JSON field/depth/duplicate policy, no extra/unexpected provenance files or duplicate/mixed authority for one domain. These refine already declared limits/manifest association and exact-limit tests; no new origin category is requested.

implementationNotes.subject: All version1-only paths
implementationNotes.detail: HealthRecoveryCopies preview currently accepts version1, absent domain.json means notIncluded; matchingManifest, hasCoveringCopy paths and generated discovery manifest matching are also version1-sensitive. Update compatible readers, carry, collision/dedupe and export authorization coherently. Corrupt or missing v2 descriptor/envelope cannot justify reuse, downgrade to version1, or reveal another readable fallback. Test mixed versions, missing/mismatched descriptors, same raw data with distinct type/code units and repeated carry.

implementationNotes.subject: Review observation acquisition
implementationNotes.detail: Acquire only genuinely eligible failed-origin observations and distinguish ineligible unavailable domains without aborting review of otherwise eligible domains. Off-main bounded work plus active-review/cancellation ownership must prevent late capture from repopulating a departed review. Selected origin set must match the selected missing-current domains exactly; no token may authorize a different domain/key or ordinary link/special target. Keep failed/ineligible domains unavailable and other healthy domains intact.
